card.name: 3-Hump Lacooda
card.officialText: If there are 3 face-up "3-Hump Lacooda" cards on your side of the field, Tribute 2 of them to draw 3 cards.

implementation.activation: Ignition effect; requires three face-up copies on the controlling team's shared Monster Zones and at least three cards in the active physical seat's Deck.
implementation.cost: Tribute exactly two eligible physical UIDs at activation; source copy may be selected or remain.
implementation.resolution: Draw three from the Deck captured for the active physical seat; if a chain link reduces the Deck below three before resolution, draw what remains and report deckOut=true for the duel engine.
implementation.negation: The two Tributes remain paid if the effect is negated; no draw is performed.
implementation.handLimit: No immediate discard; hand size may exceed six until End Phase.
implementation.ownership: Field/Graveyard are team-shared; each seat's Deck and hand remain private; ownerSeat and original object references are preserved.
implementation.teamMapping: Seats 0/2 are team 0; seats 1/3 are team 1.
implementation.tagDuelProjection: threeHumpStateFromTagDuel maps core.players[team] for active[team] and reserves[seat] for inactive seats; uses active[core.current] rather than cursor when an overflow-return seat is pending.
implementation.physicalIdentity: Physical ownership is derived from the existing TagDuel m0:–m3: UID prefix; field owner remains the controlling team.

coverage: mixed physical owners on shared field
source may be Tributed or remain
six-card hand limit deferred to End Phase
short Deck at resolution reports deck-out
projection from actual TagDuel core.players/active/reserves shape
active representative selected from active[team], including overflow-return cursor case
physical owner derived from TagDuel m0:–m3: UID prefix, no invented ownerSeat field
